categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of electronic components, including connectors, cables, and small finished products. Its products serve key sectors such as automotive advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), data centers (Cloud Center), metaverse (AR/VR), and AIoT/industrial PCs. The business also includes import and export of related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include high-frequency and high-speed transmission connectors, waterproof connectors, and automotive-grade connectors. Production methods involve metal stamping, plastic injection molding, plating, assembly, and automated optical inspection (AOI). The company emphasizes R&D in structural design, high-frequency simulation, reliability testing, and automation equipment development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are international automotive manufacturers, data center operators, industrial equipment makers, and consumer electronics companies. The company serves global markets with a focus on automotive ADAS, high-speed network communication, industrial IoT, and smart mobility sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan and China, with manufacturing facilities in Taiwan and Dongguan, China. Its sales markets include Taiwan, China, the United States, Europe, and other international regions, with significant export sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of connectors and cables. It controls key manufacturing processes such as stamping and injection molding and collaborates with suppliers for raw materials and plating services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic focus includes advancing R&D in connectors and cables for ADAS, cloud data centers, AR/VR, and AIoT/industrial PCs. R&D priorities involve high-frequency transmission, waterproofing, automotive-grade connectors, structural design improvements, reliability testing, and automation. Talent development in high-frequency simulation, mechanical and electronic design, and automation is emphasized.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of connectors, cables, and related electronic components. The company also engages in export sales and long-term strategic investments in subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include global connector manufacturers such as TE Connectivity, Amphenol, Molex, and domestic peers like Foxconn and Lixun Precision. The company positions itself as a niche player focusing on high-value automotive, industrial, and communication connectors with a growing presence in international automotive supply chains.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated net revenue of approximately NT$1.41 billion, a 2% increase year-over-year, and a net profit growth of 29%. The company maintains steady growth with increasing R&D investment (4.02% of revenue) and expanding high-margin product sales. Total assets reached about NT$3.84 billion with equity of NT$2.65 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes product quality, reliability, and innovation in high-frequency, waterproof, and automotive-grade connectors. It offers a broad and deep product portfolio tailored to niche markets such as ADAS and data centers, supported by strong R&D and automated production capabilities. The company aims to be a strategic partner to international automotive brands and high-tech industries by providing customized, high-performance connection solutions.
